<!-- REBASE-48K-20261102:BEGIN -->
## Current rebase and CI status (2026-11-02)

Head `3c70f61f29731eb3b1a9da5e6b15be862b1f96cd` is rebased onto upstream main `23c6442cde7fb38230134ba0e3513ad2332aa5cf`. The patch is unchanged according to `git range-diff`.

Local validation: 3 CPU regression tests plus 2 subtests and scoped pre-commit hooks passed; range-diff unchanged. No fresh GPU/model or performance result is claimed; earlier measurements below remain tied to their original revisions.

[Latest Base run](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41402508388) (attempt 2) stops at **Require run-ci label (optional)**. The PR is Ready. A CI-authorized maintainer must add `run-ci` and issue `/tag-and-rerun-ci`; the author-requested retry ran but cannot grant the label.

[Repository-wide lint](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/41402508194/job/125137192923) independently fails on `F821 logger` in the unchanged main XPU graph runner. [Upstream report and reproducer](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/30980#issuecomment-6571123990). The PR-scoped local hooks passed; the full upstream check has not passed. Rebase after the main repair lands.

[Rebase validation and CI request](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/46830#issuecomment-6571015382).
<!-- REBASE-48K-20261102:END -->

## Problem and root cause

DSA declares `needs_cpu_seq_lens=False`, but its eager fallback still reads GPU lengths on the host when the host mirror is absent. Under PD + DP-attention + EAGLE/MTP, busy and idle ranks can take different host-mirror branches. A blocking `.max().item()` or `.cpu()` on only some ranks can prevent them from issuing matching collectives and hang the group.

The two offending paths remain on main `8a455f1`: page-table width selection without a host mirror, and DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 host-mirror materialization. The original report observed a first-routed-request deadlock; the fresh evidence below is a CPU contract regression, not a new distributed deadlock reproduction.

## Fix

Use the static request-table width when a host length mirror is unavailable. Keep actual GPU sequence lengths for per-row bounds, and retain the narrower width when a host mirror is already present. DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 uses its supplied extend-length metadata without constructing unused host mirrors. Existing graph behavior is unchanged.

## Validation

```bash
PYTHONPATH=python python -m pytest -q test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_dsa_eager_metadata_no_host_sync.py
pre-commit run --hook-stage pre-commit --files python/sglang/srt/layers/attention/dsa_backend.py test/registered/unit/layers/attention/test_dsa_eager_metadata_no_host_sync.py
```

Rebased CPU result: **3 passed, 2 subtests passed**. Unpatched main: **2 expected failures, 1 passed, 2 subtests passed**. Tests run the actual metadata entry point, reject host reads of the device-length inputs, inspect decode/draft page tables, and retain a host-mirror control. GPU helper kernels use CPU substitutes; these are dispatch/data-contract tests. All applicable lint passed.

## Historical hardware evidence and port comparison

The production added/removed lines are identical to the original #33973 diff; this port changes placement to match main and adds registered CPU regressions. The original investigation reported that the first-request deadlock cleared on 8×MI355X with GLM-5.2-FP8, PD + DP attention + EAGLE MTP. It also recorded MI300X narrow-versus-static-width top-k checks: real selections and scores matched with per-row masking; surplus -inf slots for sequences shorter than top-k were present at both widths. See the [original verification and its limitations](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/33973).

Rechecked the current source contracts: DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 still uses the supplied extend lengths; prefix checks/ragged dispatch remain restricted to ordinary EXTEND, and the additional automatic prefill-selection use of seq_lens_sum is guarded by ForwardMode.EXTEND. The added CPU regression exercises the current metadata entry point without host reads and retains the host-mirror control. Identical patch lines do not establish identical whole-stack behavior, so the historical deployment and current CPU results are reported separately.

## Review scope and remaining coverage

Ready for review using the historical hardware evidence, unchanged production delta, current consumer audit and current-main regression coverage. A full fresh PD/DP/MTP hardware run at this head has not been performed. Broader AMD/CUDA regression, long-context memory qualification and maintainer-enabled CI remain follow-up coverage; no new throughput or whole-stack accuracy result is claimed.

This replaces closed stale draft #33973. GitHub refused reopening that PR; its discussion links here. Required upstream CI and maintainer review remain merge gates.

files.patch:
@@ -1139,7 +1139,15 @@ def init_forward_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
             # needs_cpu_seq_lens=False nulls the host mirror for spec-v2 relay
             # batches; graph replay uses the static page-table width, so only this
             # eager (e.g. over-capture-bs) fallback needs a length here.
-            max_seqlen_k = int(forward_batch.seq_lens.max().item()) + draft_token_num
+            #
+            # Use the static width rather than seq_lens.max().item(): that is a
+            # device-to-host sync, and this branch is entered per rank (an idle
+            # DP peer keeps its host mirror and takes the arm above), so under
+            # DP attention the ranks stop issuing the same collective sequence
+            # and the group deadlocks. Over-allocating columns is safe -- the
+            # page table is only indexed through top-k, which masks per row by
+            # cache_seqlens, so the extra columns are never selected.
+            max_seqlen_k = self.req_to_token.shape[1]
         # [b, max_seqlen_k]
         page_table = self.req_to_token_pool.req_to_token[
             forward_batch.req_pool_indices, :max_seqlen_k
@@ -1214,19 +1222,19 @@ def init_forward_metadata(self, forward_batch: ForwardBatch):
                 page_table, repeats=self.speculative_num_draft_tokens, dim=0
             )
         elif forward_batch.forward_mode.is_draft_extend_v2():
-            if forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu is None:
-                assert forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens is not None
-                forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu = (
-                    forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens.cpu().tolist()
-                )
-            if forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu is None:
-                forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu = forward_batch.seq_lens.cpu()
-                forward_batch.seq_lens_sum = int(forward_batch.seq_lens_cpu.sum())
+            # No host mirrors are materialized here. Both would be D2H syncs on
+            # this same per-rank branch, so with only the max_seqlen_k fix above
+            # the DP group still deadlocks. Neither is read on this path:
+            # extend_prefix_lens_cpu and seq_lens_sum are consumed only inside
+            # the is_extend() arm below, and DRAFT_EXTEND_V2 is not is_extend()
+            # (include_draft_extend_v2 defaults to False). What this branch does
+            # need -- extend_seq_lens_cpu -- is already supplied by
+            # eagle_worker_common.prepare_for_draft_extend, on the same
+            # gpu_only branch and for this same reason.
             assert (
                 forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu is not None
                 and forward_batch.extend_seq_lens is not None
-                and forward_batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu is not None
-            ), "All of them must not be None"
+            ), "extend_seq_lens{,_cpu} must not be None for DRAFT_EXTEND_V2"
 
             extend_seq_lens_cpu = forward_batch.extend_seq_lens_cpu
             assert forward_batch.extend_seq_lens is not None

@@ -0,0 +1,111 @@
+import unittest
+from types import SimpleNamespace
+from unittest.mock import patch
+
+import torch
+
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention import dsa_backend as module
+from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.dsa_topk_backend import TopkTransformMethod
+from sglang.srt.model_executor.forward_mode import ForwardMode
+from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
+
+register_cpu_ci(est_time=1, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
+
+
+class TestDsaEagerMetadataNoHostSync(unittest.TestCase):
+    def check_metadata(self, mode, host_mirror):
+        table = torch.arange(2 * 32, dtype=torch.int32).reshape(2, 32)
+        seq_lens = torch.tensor([5, 7])
+        prefix = torch.tensor([2, 4])
+        batch = SimpleNamespace(
+            batch_size=2,
+            seq_lens=seq_lens,
+            seq_lens_cpu=seq_lens.clone() if host_mirror else None,
+            req_pool_indices=torch.tensor([0, 1]),
+            forward_mode=mode,
+            extend_seq_lens_cpu=[3, 3],
+            extend_seq_lens=torch.tensor([3, 3]),
+            extend_prefix_lens_cpu=[2, 4] if host_mirror else None,
+            extend_prefix_lens=prefix,
+            extend_num_tokens=6,
+            seq_lens_sum=12 if host_mirror else 0,
+        )
+        backend = SimpleNamespace(
+            speculative_num_draft_tokens=3,
+            req_to_token=table,
+            req_to_token_pool=SimpleNamespace(req_to_token=table),
+            _kv_shard_pool=None,
+            set_dsa_prefill_impl=lambda _: None,
+            dsa_decode_impl="triton",
+            use_mha=False,
+            get_topk_transform_method=lambda _: TopkTransformMethod.PAGED,
+            dsa_index_kpool=1,
+            dsa_index_topk=4,
+            physical_page_size=1,
+            get_device_int32_arange=lambda n: torch.arange(n, dtype=torch.int32),
+            _cal_indexer_k_start_end=lambda *args: (None, None),
+            _transform_table_1_to_real=lambda table: table,
+            _build_topk_v2_plan=lambda _: None,
+            _init_kpool_metadata=lambda metadata, *args, **kwargs: metadata,
+        )
+
+        def cumulative(lengths):
+            return torch.cat(
+                (torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32), lengths.cumsum(0).to(torch.int32))
+            )
+
+        with (
+            patch.object(
+                seq_lens, "max", side_effect=AssertionError("device max/item sync")
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                seq_lens, "cpu", side_effect=AssertionError("device seq_lens copy")
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                prefix, "cpu", side_effect=AssertionError("device prefix copy")
+            ),
+            patch.object(module, "compute_cu_seqlens", side_effect=cumulative),
+            patch.object(
+                module,
+                "seqlens_expand_triton",
+                side_effect=lambda extend, lens, *args: lens.repeat_interleave(extend),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                module,
+                "compute_dsa_seqlens",
+                side_effect=lambda original_seq_lens, **kwargs: original_seq_lens.clamp(
+                    max=4
+                ),
+            ),
+            patch.object(
+                module, "pad_dsa_cache_seqlens", side_effect=lambda batch, lens: lens
+            ),
+            patch.object(module, "is_cuda", return_value=False),
+        ):
+            module.DeepseekSparseAttnBackend.init_forward_metadata(backend, batch)
+        width = 7 if host_mirror else 32
+        repeats = 3 if mode.is_draft_extend_v2() else 1
+        self.assertEqual(backend.forward_metadata.max_seq_len_k, width)
+        torch.testing.assert_close(
+            backend.forward_metadata.page_table_1,
+            table[:, :width].repeat_interleave(repeats, dim=0),
+        )
+        if not host_mirror:
+            self.assertIsNone(batch.seq_lens_cpu)
+            self.assertIsNone(batch.extend_prefix_lens_cpu)
+            self.assertEqual(batch.seq_lens_sum, 0)
+
+    def test_decode_without_host_mirror(self):
+        self.check_metadata(ForwardMode.DECODE, False)
+
+    def test_draft_extend_without_host_mirror(self):
+        self.check_metadata(ForwardMode.DRAFT_EXTEND_V2, False)
+
+    def test_existing_host_mirror_keeps_narrow_table(self):
+        for mode in (ForwardMode.DECODE, ForwardMode.DRAFT_EXTEND_V2):
+            with self.subTest(mode=mode):
+                self.check_metadata(mode, True)
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    unittest.main()
